• 1Q26 selling expenses totaled THB 99 mm, or 29.9% of 
sales, increasing from 25.3% in Q1/2025, and 22.8% in 
Q4/2025, mainly from marketing and selling expenses to 
drive sell -out. This is strategy to front -load marketing 
investments in Q1 to build sales momentum.
• 1Q26 administrative expenses were THB 41.9 million, or 
12.7% of sales, up from 10.3% in 1Q25 . mainly due to a 
lower expected credit loss (ECL) reversal (THB 0.3 million 
vs. THB 4.5 million in 1Q25), as well as higher personnel 
costs from increased headcount to support business 
expansion. 
• In 1Q26, net profit of THB 45.9 mm, up by 27.3% YoY, 
mainly due to increase in sales and gross profit. 
However, due to higher selling and administrative 
expenses as a percentage of sales, the net profit margin 
slightly decreased to 13.9% from 14.7% in 1Q25.
